title: GEORGE Interoperability Gap Analysis
description: Interoperability and FAIRness gap analysis of marine research infrastructure data services (Euro-Argo, ICOS, EMSO ERIC, and IFREMER) conducted within the Horizon Europe GEORGE project (Grant Agreement No. 101094716). Includes Jupyter notebooks assessing ODIS compliance, 5-Star Open Data maturity, and service-type interoperability across HTTPS, FTP, S3, OpenSearch, ERDDAP, OGC SensorThings API, REST JSON APIs, Web Data Portals, and SPARQL endpoints, along with supporting Docker-based knowledge graph ingestion and dereferencing tooling.
